name: aperture-attention
description: Route Codex events into evidence-backed human attention items.

interface.shortDescription: See only what deserves your attention.
interface.longDescription: A local-first Agent Attention Layer that observes Codex lifecycle events, identifies risk and decision points, verifies evidence, and renders a 30-second review.
defaultPrompt: Show my latest Aperture Attention Review.
